exceptions.rationale: Debian classifies the Trixie issue as minor/no-DSA and has no Trixie fix. The reviewed v0.20.1 Linux AMD64 Mint binary imports sscanf, contains AWS-LC markers, and contains no %mc-style format marker. Mint does not construct libc scanf format strings, and the product and dependency source are unchanged on this release-tooling branch. The exact candidate image scan remains mandatory.

Debian classifies the Trixie issue as minor/no-DSA and has no Trixie fix. The reviewed v0.20.1 Linux AMD64 Mint binary does not import ungetwc, Mint has no wide-character input path, and the product and dependency source are unchanged on this release-tooling branch. The exact candidate image scan remains mandatory.

Debian classifies the Trixie issue as minor/no-DSA and has no fixed Trixie version. The reviewed v0.20.1 Linux AMD64 Mint binary does not import ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, or fp_nquery, Mint has no DNS-printing path, and the product and dependency source are unchanged on this release-tooling branch. The exact candidate image scan remains mandatory.
